research_mode: official Department for Transport accredited statistics; fail-closed limitations; no parcel score, candidate value or business result

sources.name: Road safety strategy targets
verified_claims: The January 2026 road safety strategy set targets to reduce reported-road KSI casualties by 65% by 2035 and child KSIs by 70% by 2030 against a 2022 to 2024 baseline.
limitations: Targets are policy objectives, not observed parcel outcomes.

sources.name: Severity adjustment
verified_claims: Injury figures are adjusted to account for changes in police reporting of injury severity.
limitations: Adjustments improve comparability but may be more revisable for recently transitioned forces.

sources.name: Collision coverage
verified_claims: The statistics include police-reported public-highway collisions involving at least one motor vehicle, horse rider or pedal cyclist and at least one injured person.
limitations: There is no obligation to report every personal-injury collision to police.

sources.name: Seriously injured casualties
verified_claims: The adjusted estimate for seriously injured casualties was 28,355 in 2025, 4% higher than 2024 and 7% lower than 2015.
limitations: Adjusted national totals must not be converted directly into local risk scores.

sources.name: Slightly injured casualties
verified_claims: The adjusted estimate for slightly injured casualties was 97,959 in 2025, 1% lower than 2024 and 36% lower than 2015.
limitations: Slight injuries are particularly affected by under-reporting.

sources.name: Fatality rate
verified_claims: The estimated fatality rate was 4.5 per billion vehicle miles in 2025, 5% lower than 2024.
limitations: A national traffic-exposure rate is not a parcel probability.

sources.name: KSI rate
verified_claims: The estimated KSI rate was 86.4 per billion vehicle miles in 2025, 2% higher than 2024.
limitations: The rate depends on national traffic exposure and severity adjustment.

sources.name: All-casualty rate
verified_claims: The estimated all-casualty rate was 369.3 per billion vehicle miles in 2025, 2% lower than 2024.
limitations: The rate does not describe any individual road segment or property.

sources.name: E-scooter casualties
verified_claims: There were an estimated 1,484 casualties in collisions involving e-scooters in 2025, compared with 1,390 in 2024.
limitations: E-scooter identification and reporting changes limit local inference.

sources.name: E-scooter deaths
verified_claims: Ten people were killed in collisions involving e-scooters in 2025, all of whom were e-scooter riders, compared with 6 in 2024.
limitations: Small counts are volatile and nationally aggregated.
